clauses.clause: {R}: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: never activated on the standard board ('ability [0] not activatable from battlefield: condition:false': you control no flier). Pack goblin_bird_grabber_1 PASSES (with your 1/1 flier, {R} grants FLYING; the opponent's ground 2/2 is never offered a block; 2 damage); goblin_bird_grabber_2 PASSES (FLYING gone after end_turn). Drafts killed: REACH granted instead (pack 1), DurationPermanent (pack 2).

clauses.clause: Activate only if you control a creature with flying.
clauses.evidence: 'ability [0] not activatable from battlefield: condition:false' on the standard board, where only the opponent controls a flier (opp_flier). Pack goblin_bird_grabber_3 PASSES (refused 'illegal activation: condition:false', {R} unspent) and kills a draft with the condition dropped; pack 1 shows it allowed when you control a flier.
